caption:
If your super balance is under $500K, this rule is worth knowing.

The carry-forward rule lets you use unused concessional cap space from the last 5 financial years — all in a single year. It's automatically applied by the ATO when you lodge.

Who qualifies: your total super balance must be under $500,000 at the prior 30 June. And you need unused cap space from 2021–22 onwards.

What it means: the base concessional cap for 2026–27 is $32,500. But if you've consistently underpaid super for years, your effective cap this year could be much higher. Check your available carry-forward amount in MyGov (ATO online services → super → concessional contribution history).

The catch: you still need the cash to make the contribution before 30 June, and it must be received by your fund.
